segments.text: Good morning. I'm Sujay, and I lead engineering at Northwind Analytics.
Most retail teams still reconcile inventory by hand. It takes them four days a month.
We cut that to under six minutes, with a ninety-eight percent match rate.
We did it by treating reconciliation as a matching problem, not a reporting problem.
Our first three pilots renewed. We're at forty thousand in annual recurring revenue after one quarter.
I'd like to talk about what the next twelve months look like.
